name: Everyday Household Mayhem
description: Deceptive sound illusions from around the house, garage, and backyard.
author: Foley Master 9000

sounds.title: Violent Metallic Rattling & Thumping
sounds.soundHint: High-velocity rhythmic vibration and unbalanced shaking...
options: Unbalanced Washing Machine on Final Spin
sounds.revealTitle: Washing Machine on 1400 RPM Spin Cycle!
sounds.revealExplanation: A single wet bath towel got trapped on one side of the drum, causing the entire laundry machine to go airborne.
sounds.funFact: Unbalanced washing machines can generate centrifugal forces exceeding 300 Gs.

sounds.title: Aggressive Wet Rubber Squeals
sounds.soundHint: High-frequency rubber friction and sudden squeaks...
options: NBA Point Guard Crossover on Hardwood
Wiping a Glass Shower Door with a Dry Rag
Drifting a Go-Kart on Polished Concrete
sounds.revealExplanation: Using a microfiber cloth with maximum elbow grease to get rid of hard water stains.
sounds.funFact: Rubber and glass produce friction stick-slip acoustic oscillations exceeding 2000 Hz.

sounds.title: Sharp Crack & Painful Groan
sounds.soundHint: Sudden hard impact followed by pure regret...
options: Breaking a Wooden 2x4 with Karate Kick
Banging Knee on Underside of Work Desk
Hitting a Home Run in Baseball
Cracking a Massive Walnut with a Mallet
sounds.revealTitle: Banging Your Knee on the Office Desk!
sounds.revealExplanation: Trying to cross legs quickly under the desk during a serious video conference call.
sounds.funFact: Knee-desk collisions are the #1 reported cause of sudden involuntary mute button presses in remote work.
